task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to move south. Next, go to the east. Then, make an effort to go north. After that, make an effort to venture east. After that, recover the latchkey from the floor of the studio. And once you've done that, you win!
